title: tussilago sinuata subsp. piloselloides
intro: Tussilago sinuata subsp. piloselloides, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae, is a plant species that has been used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Tussilago sinuata subsp. piloselloides include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative, anti-allergic, and anti-ulcerative effects. The bioactive constituents of Tussilago sinuata subsp. piloselloides include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
